analyst.summary: Triveni Turbine is a well-established, financially very strong maker of industrial steam turbines, now also investing in newer heat-pump and Organic Rankine Cycle technologies. Its most recent reported quarter showed solid revenue growth, but profit grew much more slowly, a sign that margins came under some pressure even in a good quarter. The stock is also priced richly relative to its own history. We rate it a Hold: a genuinely high-quality industrial name, but not a bargain.
